newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-STRACHAN WOULD GIVE UP MEDALS TO KEEP COVENTRY UP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STRACHAN WOULD GIVE UP MEDALS TO KEEP COVENTRY UP.

text.p: Coventry manager Gordon Strachan would throw his 50 Scotland caps, F.A. Cup, Championship and European Cup Winners' Cup medals into the bin if it would save his side from relegation to the First Division, he said on Friday.

Coventry's 30-year run in the top flight is dangling by a thread and even if they manage to beat Tottenham in their last match of the season on Sunday, they will still be doomed if Middlesbrough win at Leeds or Sunderland beat Wimbledon.
"I'd give up all my medals to save us -- I'd still have my memories and that's what counts. All we can do now is go to Tottenham and give it our best shot," he said.

The combative midfielder, who pulled a hamstring in the 2-1 defeat by Derby last Saturday, has not ruled himself out of this clash. "I'd much rather be in the action on Sunday than watching from the dug-out."
